name_key.doc: The match key every alias is published under: case-folded words, qualifiers and "the" dropped. NFKC and case-folded; "&" read as "and"; parentheticals dropped; every run of other characters one space; then the words "the", "u s", "us", "united states" and "of america" dropped wherever they stand. Two strings name the same alias exactly when their keys are equal, so a consumer applies this function to its own strings and looks the key up. It is congressional-tech's em-fedagency normalizer with one repair: runs collapse before the qualifier words are dropped, so "U. S. Fish and Wildlife Service" loses its "u s".
